2607.20056.title: Language-Specific versus Cross-Lingual Knowledge Graphs for Implicit Aspect Identification in Arabic: A Comparative Study of Reasoning and Adaptation Strategies
2607.20056.paper_summary: Aspect-based sentiment analysis (ABSA) in Arabic must recover both explicitly stated aspects and implicit aspects that are never named in the text. Implicit identification typically relies on an auxiliary knowledge source (e.g., a knowledge graph (KG)) linking opinion cues to aspect categories, but for a lower-resource language the practitioner faces a design choice: reuse a mature English KG through multilingual embeddings, or build a smaller native Arabic KG. This paper reports a controlled comparison of the two strategies within a single hybrid pipeline, evaluated on three Arabic benchmarks (M-ABSA, SemEval-2016 Arabic, and HAAD). We further compare two adaptation strategies for the generative extractor that feeds the KG -- zero-shot prompting versus task-specific fine-tuning of an 8B-parameter large language model (LLM). The native Arabic KG (Strategy 2) outperforms the cross-lingual English KG (Strategy 1) by +0.199 micro-F1 on M-ABSA and +0.251 on SemEval-2016, gaining on both precision and recall. Task-specific fine-tuning raises explicit-extraction micro-F1 from <= 0.13 (zero-shot) to 0.66-0.76 on M-ABSA and SemEval-2016 (0.45 on the smaller HAAD), confirming that task adaptation, rather than model scale, is decisive in a morphologically rich language.
2607.20056.paper_summary_zh: 阿拉伯語的基於方面的情感分析（ABSA）必須恢復文本中明確陳述的方面和從未在文本中命名的隱含方面。隱含識別通常依賴於輔助知識來源（例如，知識圖譜（KG））將意見提示與方面類別連結，但對於資源較少的語言，實踐者面臨設計選擇：通過多語言嵌入重用成熟的英語KG，或構建一個較小的本土阿拉伯KG。本文報告了在單一混合管道中對這兩種策略的受控比較，並在三個阿拉伯基準（M-ABSA、SemEval-2016阿拉伯語和HAAD）上進行評估。我們進一步比較了供KG使用的生成提取器的兩種適應策略——零樣本提示與針對特定任務的微調8B參數的大型語言模型（LLM）。本土阿拉伯KG（策略2）在M-ABSA上比跨語言英語KG（策略1）高出+0.199微F1，在SemEval-2016上高出+0.251，並在精確度和召回率上均有所提升。針對特定任務的微調將明確提取的微F1從<= 0.13（零樣本）提高到M-ABSA和SemEval-2016上的0.66-0.76（在較小的HAAD上為0.45），證實了在形態豐富的語言中，任務適應而非模型規模是決定性的。
2607.20056.author: Lujain A. Alawwad et.al.
